Commentary.Commentary: Earlier, India got a great foundation courtesy a 188-run opening stand between Dhawan and Rahul. After their departure, the middle order gifted their wickets away and the home side clawed back into the contest. However, the majority of their bowlers failed to shine today morning which helped India. Lakshan Sandakan was the pick of the bowlers as he took his maiden five-wicket haul while Pushpakumara ended with three wickets. The visitors will be aiming to take early wickets to inflict more trouble on the hosts. Join us shortly for Sri Lanka's reply with the bat.

Sri Lanka will be relieved that they have at least managed to keep India under 500 but it is still a mammoth score on the board. The tourists on the back of a brilliant century from Pandya managed to go past the 450-run mark with ease. He took his chances, put the opposition bowlers under the pump who eventually crumbled under the onslaught. Hardik got good support from the tail as well.

OUT! Pandya holes out! Maiden five-wicket haul for Lakshan Sandakan. He has been smart with his variations and has rightly reaped the rewards. Tosses this one well outside off, encouraging Pandya to go for an expansive stroke. He looks to go downtown but his bottom hand comes off while playing that. He ends up slicing it over covers. Dilruwan Perera in the deep settles under it and takes it comfortably. INDIA GET BOWLED OUT FOR 487!
Very wide outside off, left alone.
Tossed up outside off, Pandya shuffles a touch and drills it to wide long off. Doesn't take the single.

We are back for the afternoon session. The Sri Lankan team is in a huddle. They will be aiming to take the final wicket quickly. Hardik Pandya and Umesh Yadav to continue their innings. Lakshan Sandakan to start off the proceedings in this session for Sri Lanka.
... Day Two, Session Two ...

Sri Lanka now seem deflated by Pandya, like a nail's effect on a tyre. They were brimming with confidence after they snaffled up Saha early in the session. The passage of play thenceforth was inspiring as Fernando was bowling probing lines to Kuldeep. But after drinks, the session swung in India's favour in quick time. Post lunch, the visitors would look to score more, while it would be interesting to see the hosts' approach. Join us in a while.

32 overs, 158 runs, 3 wickets - These figures show who bossed the session. Hardik Pandya is a name that the teams may dread in future, like Stokes these days. This innings from the all-rounder stands as a testimony to his hitting prowess. Mature and exhilarating are the two adjectives that could describe his innings so far. Kuldeep Yadav gave him able support before he departed.

Fuller in length outside off, Pandya takes a couple of steps forward and eases it to mid off for a single to retain strike. Smart cricket from him, he is aware of the game situation. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Wide outside off, Hardik doesn't fiddle with it.
Short delivery but down the leg side, Pandya leaves it alone.
Another off cutter outside off, stays low. Pandya doesn't bother to play at that one.
Another stat for the number lovers - Pandya is the 5th Indian to get a Test ton as his maiden first-class hundred.
Low full toss this time, eased to mid off.
Off cutter on a fullish length, Pandya comes forward and defends it.
Wide! Fernando steams in and bowls a bouncer wide outside off. Pandya lets it go. Wide signaled for height.
Vishwa Fernando comes back into the attack.
Fullish outside off, Yadav lunges forward and blocks it.
Loopy delivery, defended to the right side of the bowler.
Floated outside off, Yadav goes for a drive but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower delivery around off, the wrong one. Yadav looks to defend but gets beaten.
Tossed up delivery, eased to wide mid off.
Pandya becomes the first Indian in Test cricket to score hundred runs in a session before Lunch. Meanwhile, Sandakan will continue.
FOUR! Cheeky! He is toying with the Sri Lankan bowling! Shortish delivery on off, Pandya ramps it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Maiden Test hundred for Hardik Pandya.

FOUR! Take a bow, Pandya! What a knock it has been from the all-rounder, the fastest from a No. 8 in Test cricket. Fullish delivery on middle, Pandya drives it past mid on and the ball rolls to the fence. He raises his arms up and the Indian dressing room erupts with joy! Complete authority with the way he has batted today.
Very full outside off, Umesh carves it to point and sets off. Pandya responds and makes the crease in time.
Short delivery outside off, easily evaded by Yadav.
Brilliant yorker on middle, Yadav does well to jam it out beside the pitch on the leg side. He again wants a run but is sent back. Both the batsmen smile about it.
Very full on off, Yadav keeps it out towards mid off. Wants to get Pandya back on strike but he refuses. He walks to Umesh and tells him to keep his calm. He is not desperate for a century.
Shuffles a touch and clips it to short mid-wicket. Wants the run but it is not there on offer.
Wide! Well outside off this time, Pandya leaves it alone.
Shortish outside off, eased through covers. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second, Pandya is on 99 now.
50-run stand up between Hardik Pandya and Umesh Yadav.
SIX! High and mighty! Fullish on middle and leg, Pandya gets underneath it and tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Such power in that shot.
Quicker one outside off, Pandya goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge that goes through the legs of the keeper.
Shortish outside off, cut to sweeper cover. No run taken.
Wide! Bowls this wider outside off to restrict an expansive shot. Pandya can't reach it. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Outside off, left alone.
Umesh Yadav gets a change of bat now as a consequence of the broken bat.
Kumara searches for a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on middle and leg. Yadav keeps it out. Oh no! His bat has broken while he defended that. He has a wry smile about it.
Down the leg side, helped to fine leg. This time Pandya takes the run. He trusts Yadav to survive the last delivery of this over.
Fullish delivery, eased past mid off. He denies the run.
Kumara comes around the wicket now and angles it across Pandya. He pushes at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

SIX! He didn't hit this one cleanly but such is the power of the man that the ball lands into the stands! Short delivery around off, Pandya shuffles across and goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies over deep backward square leg for a maximum. He is on 90 now.
Back of a length delivery on off, Pandya hangs back and defends it stoutly.
Lahiru Kumara is back on.
Change of bat for Pandya. Wonder if he can hit even bigger sixes with this one!
Flatter one in line of the stumps, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single. Moves onto 84 with that.
Pandya again shapes for a slog but Sandakan smartly bowls it wide outside off. He can do nothing about it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish delivery, driven from the toe end back to the bowler.
Wide outside off, Pandya was looking for a big hit but has to leave it.

Coming in with the angle, Yadav looks to block it but the ball goes through the gap between his bat and pad. Beats the keeper as well. However, it is signaled as a run by the umpire. There was no bat involved actually.
Eased to covers this time.
Looks to take a run to retain strike but misses to get hit on the pads. This is a lottery over for the Indian side. This is the highest runs scored in an over in Tests by an Indian.
SIX! Pushpakumara comes around the wicket and gives it air. Pandya gets his dancing shoes on again and hammers it over long on for the third maximum in a row. 26 from the over already.
SIX! Carnage from Pandya! Floated delivery, Hardik uses his feet and bludgeons it over the bowler's head for a maximum. That's the 450 up for India.

SIX! The bowler is under the pump now. Tosses this one up on off, Pandya dances down the track and goes downtown. Has hit that straight as an arrow and the ball lands over the sightscreen. This is now the most no. of maximums scored by a visiting side in a Test series in Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Pandya is turning it on! He is such a clean striker of the cricket ball, a sheer delight to watch! Uses his feet and hammers it past the left side of the bowler to find the long off fence.
FOUR! Hit with disdain! In the zone for Pandya. He kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.
There is a straight long on in place. Lunch will be delayed as the last pair is batting out there.
Turned through mid-wicket for a single.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. Wide signalled by the umpire.

SIX! Boom! Pandya uses his feet as Sandakan bowls it wider outside off. The all-rounder does well to reach out and lifts it over wide long off. The fielder in the deep has no chance of catching it as it sails overs the ropes. This is already the highest score at this venue in Tests.
Pandya sweeps the fullish delivery to deep square leg. He declines the single this time.
Outside off, Yadav cuts it through point for a run.
Umesh Yadav is the last man in.

OUT! Shami gets lured into a false stroke and pays the price for it! Slow through the air around off, Shami takes a couple of steps down the track and drills it back towards Sandakan. He is alert, positions himself well and takes a reverse cup near his face. Sandakan gets his third wicket, he has bowled well.
Shorter outside off, Shami goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper.
This is the first time India has managed to score 400 in the first innings in each Test of a series in Sri Lanka.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

A loud appeal for an LBW falls on deaf ears! Quicker through the air, it is the arm ball. Shami looks to keep it out but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. The Sri Lankans appeal but the umpire stays put. The replays confirm there was an inside edge. Wise call to not take the review.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
2nd Test fifty for Hardik Pandya.
Pandya eases this one through mid off to bring up his second Test fifty! He has been very impressive with the bat and is proving his worth.
Pandya was seen clutching his groin after running the second run in the previous over.
Floated delivery, Shami eases it through mid off for a single.
Pushed back to the bowler off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Pandya goes for the cut but misses.
Good running! Outside off, Pandya plays it off the outer half behind point. Calls for the second and completes it with ease.

SIX! Great hit! He goes against the spin and connects well. Floated around off, Pandya comes down the track and hammers it towards wide long on. Perera in the deep runs to his left and leaps but can only watch it sail over him for a maximum.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! The tailender is capable with the bat and here is an example of that. Shorter in length and it is the wrong one. Shami stays back, reads it well and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Slow through the air outside off, Pandya uses his feet and drills it to long off for a run. Exposes Shami for the five deliveries of this over.
Pandya turns this one past short leg for a single.
Fullish this time, knocked to long off for a run.
Tossed up delivery, eased to covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Arm ball from Pushpakumara. Shami looks to defend it but is hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal but it was clearly going down leg.
Floated delivery, slog swept to deep square leg for a run.
Mohammed Shami is the new man in.

OUT! The on-field call stays! Floated on off, turns away after pitching. Yadav prods forward to counter it but only manages to get a faint outside edge. Dickwella behind the stumps collects it nicely and appeals. Up goes the umpire's finger. Kuldeep however opts for a review. Turns out to be a wasted one as the Snickometer spots the nick. The southpaw walks back after a stubborn knock. The 62-run stand is broken by Sandakan.
Kuldeep has opted to take a review against a caught behind decision.
Yadav comes down the track and Sandakan bowls it wider. Yadav does well to block it.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Floated delivery, defended to short leg.
Uses his feet, is not quite to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

Russel observes that Pandya camps on the back foot, which makes it easier for him to punish the short balls that the Lankans feed him with. The wagon wheel is also a proof of the fact that the pull shot has been productive for the all-rounder. So Arnold believes that the hosts need to change their bowling plans against Hardik.
Tossed up delivery, patted back to the bowler.
Turned to the leg side.
Tossed up delivery, Pandya uses his feet and milks it to long on for a single. 400 up for India. This is the second time a visiting side has scored 400 in all the three Tests in Sri Lanka.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated around off, Pandya is eager to come down the track but blocks it by staying back.
Shortish in length, punched off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Floated on off, Yadav drags it off the toe end to mid on.
Keeps his eyes on the ball till the last moment and plays it with the spin towards point.
Loopy delivery outside off, Yadav leans forward and blocks.
Flighted delivery, Yadav lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up outside off, Yadav plants his front foot across to let it go.
A bit shorter on off, pushed off the back foot back to the bowler.
This time he goes for the conventional sweep but gets an under edge past the keeper. A run taken.
Flighted delivery around leg stump, Yadav goes for the fancy reverse sweep but the ball turns away to beat him.
He is nimble on his feet again and drives it past the right side of the bowler. A single taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Shot! Slow through the air on middle, Pandya comes down the track and lifts it over mid on to find the fence. That almost went for a maximum.
Floated on middle and leg, Yadav works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Malinda Pushpakumara to bowl for the first time today. The umpire had a chat with Chandimal about the over rate. Sri Lanka for sometime now have had an issue about slowing the game too much.
50-run stand up between Kuldeep Yadav and Hardik Pandya, which is the highest stand at this venue for the 8th wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Yadav goes for a drive but gets it off the outer half through the vacant slip region. Three runs taken.

Yadav uses his feet and pushes it past Sandakan. Mathews at mid on runs to his right, gets a hand to it but fails to stop it. Pandya runs well past the striker's end but Kuldeep is aware of the situation. He calls him through as the mid off fielder tracks it down. Two taken in the end.
Outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
A bit short outside off, spinning away. Kuldeep shapes for the cut but lets it go.
Slow through the air on middle, worked past short leg for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, Pandya goes at it with hard hands but mistimes it to covers.
Short delivery outside off, pulled through square leg for a run.
Low full toss on the pads, Yadav clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Similar length outside off, played with an angled bat to the off side.
Back of a length delivery, angling in. Kuldeep looks to tuck it away but is hit on the thigh pad.
Length delivery on off, stays low. Yadav does well to keep it out.
Short delivery, Yadav sways away from the line of the delivery.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Quicker one outside off, Kuldeep goes for a full blooded sweep but gets beaten. He then loses his balance and falls over as Dickwella takes the bails off. Two false shots from him.
Flighted well outside off, Yadav uses his feet and is beaten in the flight but does well to block it.

Tossed up delivery, spinning down. Yadav looks to sweep hard but misses. Dickwella waits for a bit, takes the bails off and appeals. The square leg umpire has a wry smile on his face. The replays show that Kuldeep's foot was in the air for a moment but was down in time.
Vicious turn! A bit flatter on off, turns away sharply after pitching. Yadav looks to defend it off his back foot but is beaten completely.
Fullish delivery outside off, crunched through covers for a run.
Similar length delivery on off, Yadav gets behind the line and defends it stoutly.

Back of a length delivery, angling down the leg side. Kuldeep lets it go. Kumara has failed to maintain consistent lines and lengths. Simon Doull on-air mentions that Lahiru has ability but he is not executing it well.
Well-directed bouncer on off, Kuldeep drops his wrists, sways away from the line and evades it.
Fuller in length outside off, Pandya is on the move and drives it sweetly to sweeper cover for a single.

Leg bye! Length delivery going down the leg side, stays a touch low as well. Yadav looks to help it away but misses to get hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Good awareness by the batsmen as they steal a leg bye.
Short delivery, sits up nicely for Pandya. Pulled hard to deep square leg for a run.
Lahiru Kumara is back on.

A loud appeal for an LBW denied! Tossed up outside off, it is the wrong one. Yadav prods forward to counter it but misses to get struck on the pads. However, the umpire is not interested in the appeal. The impact was in question. In fact, the replays show there was an inside edge.
Floated delivery, Pandya drives it to the left side of Sandakan who dives but fails to stop it. A single results.
Spinning into Hardik. He defends it nicely with the spin.
Floated in line of the stumps, patted back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Yadav drives it crisply to sweeper cover. A single taken.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, Pandya turns it through mid-wicket for a run.

The Sri Lankan side is in a huddle. A pep talk from the skipper Chandimal. Let's see if it works for his side. Change in bowling. Lakshan Sandakan comes into the attack. A slip and short leg in place.

It's drinks time after an hour of play! After picking up an early wicket, Sri Lanka are bowling probing lengths but are still left searching for wickets. Pandya has looked solid so far and has played his shots too. Kuldeep has had a few plays and misses but is still battling on. The hosts would like to have a wicket-taking potion with the drinks!
Length ball outside off, Kuldeep fishes at that and misses.
Bouncer outside off, swayed away from by Yadav.
Fuller ball outside off, driven straight to wide mid off.
A tad fuller around off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Bowls a length ball outside off, which is played to gully.
Length ball outside off and angling in, left alone by KY.
This one's blocked off the front foot.
Fuller ball on off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Fuller ball outside off, played to deep cover for a run.

FOUR! Kuldeep gets into the act now. Full and wide of off, Kuldeep Yadav opens the face of his bat and guides it to the backward point fence for a boundary. That was smart, considering there was a man in front of square on the off side.
Full ball outside off, played back over the leaping bowler for a run.
Fuller ball wide of off, hit straight to covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, Kuldeep tries to fiddle with that. The ball passes the outside edge of the bat and goes to the keeper.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Length ball outside off, punched to mid off.
Fuller ball around off, flicked away through mid-wicket. The batsmen decide to run two and make it comfortably.
Length ball around off, pushed to the off side.
FOUR! Smashed smartly! Short ball around off, Pandya pulls it off the front foot through mid-wicket for a boundary. It raced away in a jiffy!
This ball's a tad shorter just outside off, left alone again.
Fuller ball outside off, left alone.
A tad fuller, pushed through mid-wicket for a run. The bowler himself rushed and threw back the ball. Pandya thought of a second quite late there.
This one's defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Length ball pushed straight to cover.
Long off in place now, along with sweeper cover and deep point.
Length ball outside off, Pandya looks to force the shot through the off side, misses completely.
Dimuth Karunaratne to have a bowl.
Fuller ball outside off, Yadav comes forward to defend but gets beaten.

Kuldeep caught by surprise with that nippy delivery. Started well outside off and came back sharply, the ball missed Kuldeep's bat and struck him high on the front pad and went to the keeper. The Lankans put up an LBW appeal only to see it turned down. Hawk Eye showed that it would miss the stumps.
Shorter ball outside off, Yadav pokes his bat and gets beaten.
Fuller ball defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! STREAKY YET EFFECTIVE! Back of a length ball outside off, Kuldeep pokes his bat at that. The ball takes the outside edge and falls short of the slips and races away through the gap between second and third slip for a boundary.
Harmless length ball way outside off, left unharmed by Kuldeep.
Length ball outside off, pushed to mid off, off the back foot.
Fuller ball outside off, driven through cover-point for a run.
Fuller ball around off, pushed defensively to the off side.
Another short ball outside off, Yadav sways away to let the ball go to the keeper.
Pandya is having a chat with Kuldeep. The talk will be to keep going and build up a handy partnership.
A tad fuller ball, driven to the cover fielder.
Length ball outside off, he poked his bat to see the ball pass the bat.
WIDE! Round the wicket steams in Kumara, bowls a bouncer at Kuldeep who ducks. Wide given as it passed over the batsman's head.
Length ball around off, played towards cover-point for a run.
Full ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller ball outside off, Yadav strides forward to defend but gets it off the outer edge to gully.
Length ball angling in to Kuldeep's off stump, he plays it with an angled bat to gully.
A tad fuller ball outside off, too far to make Kuldeep play though.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone. There was a little bit of movement there as the ball went to the keeper.
Full ball outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Back of a length ball bowled from wide of the crease. Pandya bent a little as he defended that, suggesting that the ball stayed a tad low.
Length ball outside off, dabbed straight to gully.
Chandimal has a chat with Kumara. Might be regarding the field placements.

FOUR! Crunched crisply! Short ball outside off, Pandya stands tall and punches it through covers. He hit it powerfully with good timing. The ball rushes away to the fence beating sweeper cover. That brings up the 350 for the visitors.
Bruce Oxenford has recovered from his illness and he is back as the TV umpire.
Back of a length ball on his hips, tucked away to fine leg for a run.
Length ball around off, pushed to the covers. Pandya wanted a single but was sent back.

Good ball, that makes Pandya a tad uncomfortable! Back of a length ball on off and middle, nipping into him, the batsman gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball hits the back thigh and goes to the keeper, who along with the bowler appeals. The umpire turns it down.
Length ball outside off, played off the back foot to the cover fielder.
Length ball around off, a single taken after playing to point.
Fuller ball outside off, draws Kuldeep forward and moves away. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Another length ball outside off, shouldered arms to.
Length ball, too wide to make Kuldeep play.
Back of a length ball nipping into him, Pandya defends a bit awkwardly.
A tad fuller ball around middle and leg, turned away through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball blocked from his crease.
Fuller ball on his pads, played away to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! The upper cut from Pandya fetches him runs. That is another short ball on off and middle, Hardik sways back and just helps it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Bouncer for Pandya, who goes for the hook but misses.
Length ball outside off, poked but gets beaten.
Another full ball around off and middle, pushed through mid on for a brace.

Wonderful ball first up. Fuller ball around off, Yadav looks to push defensively with a closed bat face. The bat hits his pad and the ball goes through to the keeper and the Lankans put up an appeal. The umpire stays put. The replays show that the impact was outside the line. Actually the ball did not brush anything on its way.
Kuldeep Yadav walks in to bat.

OUT! Early success for Sri Lanka and Fernando. Back of a length ball outside off, Saha sees an opportunity to collect runs. He cuts that but does so straight to Perera at gully, who takes a smart catch. Probably that bounced more than he expected, but he could have done better there. This will pump the hosts up.
Length ball outside off, punched through covers for a brace. He played that off the back foot.
Length ball around off, Saha again gets it off the inner half of the bat to the bowler as he looks to play to the off side.
Dickwella is getting some taping off his fingers. Meanwhile, Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Bowled on a length on his pads, tucked away to fine leg for a single.
A tad fuller around off, Saha looks to push it on the off side, ends up getting it off the inner half of his bat on to the pads and rolls back towards the bowler.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of his bat to the fielder at deep square leg for a run.
Bowls on a length in line of the stumps, Pandya plays it of the front foot showing the full face of the bat.
FOUR BYES! Length ball outside off, swings in after it passes the batsman. It dips as it reaches Dickwella, who gets an awkward bounce just before him, and races away to the fence.
Off straightaway! Full ball outside off, Pandya drives it through covers for a brace. The fielder chased it and threw it at the bowler's end, which hit Saha.
We are set to get underway. Wriddhiman Saha and Hardik Pandya to continue their innings. Lahiru Kumara to open the bowling this morning. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Pitch Report - Simon Doull and Russel Arnold are out there. Russel feels that it's crucial to make early inroads. About the pitch he says that it is still pretty good and there is some sweat due to the overnight rain. He feels that it could be lively and helpful to the bowlers at the start.

A warm welcome to all on a pleasant morning for the second day's play of the final Test between Sri Lanka and India in Pallekele. This is the first time in the series where the hosts end up being on par with the visitors. The most even day of play in this series saw India lose 6 wickets for a reasonable score, with the Lankan bowling showing some spine and control to keep the visitors in check. Stay with us as we bring you all the live action.
... Day Two, Session One ...

The Indians, on the other hand, have a right to be disappointed today. Scoreboard tells a story, batsmen did get starts but didn't bat to get a big score. What the scorecard doesn't say though, is that most of them departed playing shots that they could have done without. Rahul and Dhawan did give the rest a good platform with a 188-run opening stand, but they didn't capitalize on it. They still have batsmen in the hut, who would aim to stretch the score as far as possible. Do join us tomorrow at 1000 local time (0430 GMT) for what could be another riveting day of cricket. Till then, take care. Adios!

A good day of Test cricket comes to an end. 34 overs, 94 runs and 3 wickets in this session shows that it was an even session for both sides. This was the first time in the series when Sri Lanka actually turned up, it seemed. Their bowlers, led by Pushpakumara, tested the Indian batsmen and kept them in check. Bad balls were few and far between today from the hosts. Runs were hard to come by and most of the catches offered today were held on to, unlike earlier in the series. Fernando was also largely impressive, especially towards the end.
Fernando angles across a length delivery well outside off, Saha simply leaves it alone. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Length delivery on middle and off, straightening up a shade, Saha defends it from within his crease by taking his bottom hand off.
Hardik is off the mark. Drives it to mid off and snatches a quick run.
Spears it down the leg side, Pandya looks to get something on it but misses.
On the body once more, Saha works it through backward square leg and takes a single.
Shortish on the body, awkwardly fended away on the leg side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the shorter side of things again, punched to backward point off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed just wide of gully but still no run.
Coming back in on a back of a length, worked in front of FSL from within the crease.
Just back of a length, outside off, punched through towards sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Now Saha survives! Has no idea what's going on with this. Back of a length ball which just kicks off the deck, takes the little man by surprise as he just hangs his bat out. It goes off his arm and over the slip cordon for a boundary. Leg byes signalled.
The hard hitting Indian all-rounder Hardik Pandya strides out at the fall of the 6th wicket.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Went fetching for a wide one and paid the price for it. Well outside off on a back of a length, Ashwin fishes for it and gets an edge. Flies behind where Dickwella dives full stretch to his right and takes a sensational catch. Sri Lanka with a much-needed wicket towards the end of day's play. Good stuff from them.
Yorker fired wide outside off, left alone.
Cutting back in on middle and leg, clipped through square leg. One run added to the total.
Bit fuller in length, swinging back in on middle and leg, Saha leans forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Hangs inside his crease and with minimal foot movement, dabs it to gully.
Short of a good length angling well across, Saha looks to make contact with an angled bat but fails to do so.
Vishwa Fernando will have a change of ends.
Good length ball just outside off, dabbed to backward point.
Full ball just outside off, Ashwin moves across a touch to drive but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full length delivery shaping back in, Ashwin pushes it back down to the left of the bowler.
Full toss wide outside off, the Indian wicketkeeper batsman reaches out and places it to the sweeper as he jogs across.
On a good length just outside off, Saha covers the line well and shoulders his arms to it.
Low full toss on the fourth stump line, punched through point for one.
Lahiru Kumara brought back on.
Another lunge forward, defends it right under his nose.
Slower through the air, on off and spinning away, Saha has to wait for it for a second before he buries it into the track.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Keeps tossing it up there, Wriddhiman strides ahead and blocks.
Gives it a lot of flight, around off, tapped away to backward point with a slightly opened face.
Full ball drifting in on off, Saha presses forward and meets the ball at its pitch.
Nudges it fine down the leg side and gets a couple of runs for doing so.
Punches this into the off side but no run is taken.

Not out! Clearly. Length delivery shaping back in, Ashwin defends it onto his pads and the ball dies down safely near him. Chandimal reviews and replays show the batsman is safe. Waste of a review, really.
A review! For an lbw appeal against Ravichandran Ashwin. Not sure why though, it's clear there's bat involved. Going to be a poor review.
Swinging back in from a good length, on the stumps, Ashwin takes his front leg out of the way and meets the ball with his bat.
FOUR! Easy as they come. It's sprayed on the pads and all Ashwin has to do is tickle it fine down the leg side. He does so and sends it across the fine leg fence.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, kept out by getting behind the line.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl a spell with the second new ball.

An analysis of Pushpakumara reveals that he had a forgettable debut because he was bowling way shorter and slower, thereby giving the batsmen ample time to play their shots. Today he has been bowling fuller and also tossing it up a bit more. Hence, the wickets column also has a favourable number for him.
Comes half-forward and blocks it out with the full face of the bat.
Driven through the covers for a run.
On the stumps, Ashwin looks to play but is caught on the pads. Big shout, shut down. Bat first probably. That's the only thing that could have saved him.
Drifting in on middle and off, Ashwin with a big lunge forward defends.
Pushed through, still some grip and turn for Malinda. Ashwin is taken by surprise and somehow awkwardly defends it to cover.
Ashwin taps this tossed up ball outside off to point.
Sri Lanka have taken the second new ball. Would be interesting to see how much purchase they get from it.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Flat on off, opens the bat face and dabs it to point for one.
Some flight from Lakshan, Saha kneels forward and across to sweep it on the full. Through backward square leg and a single is taken.
Straighter one on middle, keeps low and skidding from the surface, Saha does well to get back and bring a straight blade down to keep it out.
Flat and short on leg, goes back and glances it to short fine leg once again.
Going down the leg side, paddled to short fine leg. Dot ball.
Clears his front leg and pushes the full delivery to the covers.
Works it against the spin through the mid-wicket area and fetches himself a single.

Ooooohhhh.... Saha is lucky to survive! Pushpakumara with a slider on leg, it's going on with the angle and keeps very, very low. Catches Wriddhiman on the pads and there's an appeal. Was sliding down leg though, so turned down.
Blocked into the cover region for a brisk run.
Takes a big stride forward to negate the spin and deals with it comfortably.

Could have been run out. Quite easily too, lucky to survive. Ashwin adjusts his body and clips it towards short fine leg. Saha without even looking is halfway down the track. Is sent back, fortunate that Dickwella couldn't collect cleanly.
Short outside off, punched through towards sweeper cover. One run taken.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Looped up from Sandakan, Saha is down and paddles it on the full. Behind square on the leg side and a brace is taken.
Decent placement. Saha stays back and is able to work it just wide of the mid off fielder. Two runs are taken as he chases it down.
Full delivery, driven straight back to the bowler.
Landed on a shorter length, forced to the cover area as he jogs across.
Another one on the fuller side, blocked.
Full on the stumps, a front foot defensive shot presented by Wriddhiman Saha.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and outside off, spinning away, a solid punch to cover.
With a shimmy down the track, Ashwin wrists it wide of mid on and steals a single.
Turning away from around off, Ashwin drops this with gentle hands on the off side.
Ruchira Palliyaguruge is the stand-in TV umpire, as Bruce Oxenford has taken ill and has stayed back in the hotel.
Extremely full on off, drilled straight to the mid off fielder to end a successful over from Lakshan Sandakan.
Plays it with the spin and turns it in front of square leg for nothing.
Well outside off, left alone.

NOT OUT! SAHA SURVIVES! Good decision by the TV umpire in all honesty. Flighted right up there, outside off, Saha attempts to drive it through the covers but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes past the bat and into the keeper's gloves. Loud shout from Dickwella, convinces his skipper to take the review as the umpire doesn't show any interest. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the noise is of the bat hitting the ground and not the ball.
And instantaneously, Saha is in the midst of all the drama. There is a caught behind appeal against him and it has been reviewed by Sri Lanka.
Wriddhiman Saha is the new man in for India.

OUT! KOHLI DEPARTS! This is a big, big wicket for the hosts. The Indian skipper has been sent back and at a crucial juncture too. Tossed up well outside off and Kohli is seen going after this. Attempts to play his whippy cover drive and ends up getting a thick edge behind to Karunaratne at first slip, who takes a very good catch.
Goes deep inside his crease and turns it on the leg side.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fired full and outside off, Kohli is forward to drive but somehow slices it behind point for two.
Comfortable run. Just pushed through the covers for a single.
Tad short and outside off, cut away hard straight to backward point.
Reaches out to this full ball and pushes it to covers.
Sliding in on middle and off, attempting to pierce the gap between bat and pad, but Ashwin is tight in defense as he keeps bat and pad close together.
Full, fast and on the pads, Virat attempts to turn it on the on side but is caught on the pads.
Waits for the ball to come to him, open the face and dabs it through backward point. The man in the deep runs to his left and mops it up. Two runs taken.
Fired outside off, the wrong 'un, Kohli reads it well and hence, is able to leave it alone.
Full and straight, hit back to the bowler.
Slider aimed at off, the batsman is half-forward as he blocks it out.
Easily done. Knocks it through the cover area and takes one.
Tossed up outside the line of off stump, Virat looks to drive hard but ends up slicing it towards backward point.
Fullish in length, just outside off, Kohli with a nice stride forward blocks it in front of covers.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Less turn for Malinda on this one, Ravi Ash in forward in defense.
Short on off, fast and flat, Ashwin backs away as he cuts it to backward point.
Good use of the feet from Ashwin to get to the pitch of the ball. Flicks it well through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Quicker ball targeting the off stick, placed to point with an open face. Single to end the over.
A bit fuller than Sandakan would have liked, Ashwin jams it out towards mid off.
Picks it off his pads and clips it in front of square on the leg side.
Bit quicker through the air, on a fuller length on middle and leg, Ashwin presses ahead and blocks.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, driven down to long on for an easy one.
Full delivery on middle and leg, off the inner half Virat clips it wide of backward square leg for a couple.
Lakshan Sandakan is back to bowl.
Flighted ball on off, comes forward and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Slider on off, skids off the deck and keeps a little low too. Hurries onto Ashwin who manages to cut it away behind point. Two runs are taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Some good turn for Pushpakumara. He nicely tosses it up around off and makes it spin away. Ashwin is forward in defense and it beats the outside edge of his bat.
Nice drift into the batsman, Kohli clears his front leg and drives it to wide mid off for a single.

Drinks have been called for one final time today. Both sides have put up an even show till this point in the session. While the Lankans have succeeded in stemming the run flow, Kohli and Ashwin are battling it out after the fall of Rahane.
Fuller ball down the leg side. Ashwin tried to flick and missed.
Good length ball around middle and leg, pushed defensively to mid on.
Short ball around off, Ashwin bails out of the shot and lets the ball go unharmed to the wicketkeeper.
Full toss tailing in a tad, Ashwin punches it to the cover fielder off the front foot.
Short and wide of off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Full ball on middle and leg, flicked away in front of square on the leg side for a single.
This loopy ball is flicked towards short mid-wicket. Ashwin wanted a run but rightly denied by Kohli.
Floated ball is blocked from the crease.
Looped up ball around middle pushed a tad aerially back towards the bowler.
Tosses that outside off, driven straight to the short cover fielder.
Flighted ball, blocked by Ashwin bringing out his big stride.
Tossed up ball coming into the batsman with the angle, he tucks it to deep square leg and runs away to the other side.
Full and on his pads, Ashwin clips it all along the ground to short mid-wicket, who makes a half-stop. The ball rolls towards mid on, they don't take a run.
Length ball on off, Ash blocks from within the crease.
Fuller ball outside off, Kohli nudges it towards cover-point for a single. The fielder at covers runs there to field that.
Bouncer for Kohli, who ducks under that and lets the keeper do his bit.
Length ball on his pads, Ashwin tucks it through square leg for a run. He slips as he completes that run.
Full ball tailing in a bit, played to mid on.
Lahiru Kumara brought back for another spell.
Tossed up on off, defended off the back foot.
A back foot defense on display to that flighted ball.
Kohli gets behind the line of the ball and defends that.
Flatter ball in line of the stumps, played through wide mid on for a single.
Ashwin bunts this ball in line of the stumps on to the ground.
Slower through the air outside off, Ashwin blocks from his crease.
This one's bowled outside off, played towards point for a run.
Tossed up around off, RA strides forward and blocks.
A wrong 'un well read and played by Ashwin by opening the face of his bat and guiding it through point for a couple.
Floated down the leg side, Ash tries to sweep and misses.
Tossed up outside off, Ashwin times it sweetly through covers for a brace. He didn't try to hit it too hard. Sweeper cover had to slide to save runs.
Flatter ball outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Flighted ball outside off, played to covers. They thought about a single and aborted.
Tosses it around middle, Ashwin takes a couple of steps down the ground and pushes it to mid on.
That's bowled around off, punched away towards covers.
Loopy ball around middle, played to short leg.
Slower through the air around off and middle, Ravi defends off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery around leg, Kohli plays it wide of mid on for a run.
Flatter ball around off, punched away through covers for a run.
Tossed up way outside off, Kohli doesn't bother to play at that.
A tad shorter this time, Ashwin goes back and slaps it through covers for a run to get going in this innings.
That's looped up on off, Ashwin strides forward and defends.
Flighted ball on middle and leg, punched off the back foot to long on for one run.
Mid on drops back...
Tossed up ball outside off, Kohli gets to the pitch and mistimes it straight to mid off.
Flighted ball around off and middle, defended off the front foot by Ashwin.
Tossed up, pushed towards covers.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes in to bat at no. 6.

OUT! Pushpakumara is doing the wicket-taking stuff today! Rahane plays a shot that he could have done without. Loopy ball around off and middle, Rahane looks to flick it towards the on side by taking a lunge forward. He missed the ball completely and finds the woodwork disturbed. The ball stayed a tad low and also he played for the turn that wasn't there. Another Indian wicket falls to spin in Pallekele.
Loopy ball on off, played from within the crease.
Tossed up around middle and off, played towards covers for a quick single. The fielder had a shy at the non-striker's end but missed.
That's floated gently on middle, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up ball around off, Rahane looks to play towards covers and gets it off the inside of his bat back to the bowler.
Looped up ball is played straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Flatter ball on his pads, flicked towards short fine leg. They thought of a single and decided against it.
Loopy ball around off, placed towards covers for a run.
Loopy ball on middle, pushed off the front foot on the off side.
Tossed up around off, Kohli plays it with soft hands towards covers. Rahane wants a single, but an early negation from Kohli saves India a wicket.
Bunts that looped up delivery on to the ground.
Now Rahane defends the flighted ball by Pushpakumara off his front foot.
Tossed up around off, driven through mid off for a run.
This one's given some air around middle, Virat shows his defensive skills yet again.
Looped up around middle and leg, Kohli defends it by getting right over the ball.
Floated outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Malinda Pushpakumara comes on.
Floated outside off, Rahane goes for the sweep and misses.
Another solid defense on display for the flighted ball in line of the stumps.
Loopy ball, defended showing the full face of the bat.
FOUR! BANGED AWAY! Short wrong 'un on middle, Rahane rocks back and pulls it away through mid-wicket for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Tosses it outside off and spinning in to Rahane. He strides forward in defense, but the ball misses his bat and strikes him on his pad. The Lankans appeal, which the umpire turns down and after some thought they decide to review. There is no bat involved and the Ball Tracker shows that even though the pitching and impact are in line, the ball would go on to miss the leg stump. Strange to see the projection show so much turn on the first day itself, given it hasn't nearly turned this much all day. Anyway, the on-field decision stays, owing to which Sri Lanka lose a review. Rahane bats on.
A review has been taken by Sri Lanka for an lbw decision against Ajinkya Rahane.
Loopy ball down the leg side spinning away. Rahane plays and sees the ball pass past his edge and go into the keeper's gloves. They appeal but to no avail.
Fuller ball around off, flicked to mid on.
Length ball on off, defended from within the crease.

FOUR! Lovely, lovely shot. Full ball outside off, inviting the drive from Kohli. He is too good to miss out on his favourite stroke, he plays it to perfection and collects a boundary through the covers. That was one you could have watched on loop.
Full ball outside off, driven to mid on.
A tad fuller outside off, Kohli blocks it after getting behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Kohli points his bat skywards as he lets Dickwella do the rest.
This flighted ball is blocked by Rahane by getting behind the line of the delivery.
Another loopy ball well defended by Rahane.
Lakshan gives it some air, Rahane defends showing the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on his pads, tucked away past square leg for a brace.
Floated around middle, blocked off the front foot by Jinx.
Loopy ball on leg and middle, defended solidly off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to let it go.
A tad fuller outside off, pushed defensively towards covers.
Length ball outside off, Kohli defends it off the front foot to cover-point.
Length ball outside off, Ajinkya plays it towards deep point for one run.
That's too wide to make him play.
Rahane shoulders arms to that length ball outside off.
This one's given more air, Kohli plays it off the back foot.
Flatter ball on his pads, flicked straight to square leg.
Another ball blocked off the back foot.
Floated up in line of the stumps, Kohli goes back and defends showing the full face of the bat.
Tossed up down the leg side, Kohli misses the flick and wears it on his pads.
Googly outside off, played towards deep point for one run.
Another ball outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Another beautiful cover drive, finds the fielder this time.
FOUR! CRISP KOHLI SPECIAL! Fuller ball outside off, Virat leans forward and drives it through the cover region. The sweeper didn't have any chance as the ball raced away.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Starts off with a length ball on middle and leg, Kohli clips it past the diving square leg fielder. The fielder in the deep runs to field that and keeps it to two.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Flatter delivery on his pads, Rahane rocks back and tucks it off his pads towards fine leg for another couple.
Another loopy ball bunted on to the ground.
Loopy ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Floated up around off, Rahane drives it through covers for another brace.
Mid on going back now.
Tossed up around off, punched to covers.
Shorter outside off, Rahane rocks back and punches it off the back foot through covers. Chandimal puts in a slide while the batters take two.
The umpires and the players walk to what could be an exciting passage of play. Kohli and Rahane will resume their innings for India, while Sri Lanka start with Sandakan.
... Day One, Session Three ...

29 overs, 101 runs and 3 wickets - This summarizes the story of this session. The runs have come, but Sri Lanka will be the happier lot having sent back the set batsmen and picking up Pujara's wicket as well. Malinda Pushpakumara has been the pick of the bowlers, sending both the openers back. Sandakan has kept things tight at one end and even scalped a wicket of his own. It's set up now for an exciting final session. It'll begin shortly, so don't go anywhere...
Similar ball, similar shot/lack of shot. That will be it, TEA ON DAY 1!
Another left alone. We're at the stroke of the break, so the Indian captain doesn't want to take any unnecessary risks.
Too far outside off, VK covers the line and lets it be.
Good save from Dilruwan. Moving away from outside off, Kohli plays away from his body and dabs it toward gully. Perera there quickly dives low to his right and makes a one-handed stop.
Going well across Virat Kohli, he wants nothing to do with it.
Back of a length on the stumps, Kohli moves a step across and works it the man in front of square on the leg side.
Wrong 'un outside off, Rahane offers a back foot punch but is beaten past the outside edge.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Reaches out to it a bit and pushes it into the covers for one run.
Another flick to mid-wicket, to the fielder yet again. Dot ball.
Plants his front foot forward and dead-bats it into the track.
Brings his wrists into play and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and wide, cut hard through point. Sandakan out in the deep does well to move to his left and makes a good tumbling stop. Saves two runs for his side.
Short of a good length close to off, looks to punch it away on the off side but mistimes it towards point.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
With an open-faced blade, Rahane moves across and dabs it to gully.
Fraction straight in line, turned on the leg side for nothing.
Angling across from a length, around off, Ajinkya presents a tight defensive shot to keep it out.
Off the mark finally. Rahane knocks it to mid on and takes the fielder on. Beats his throw and completes the run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
BEATEN! The Indians are having a difficult time picking up Sandakan. Googly on off, spins away sharply and beats the outside edge of Ajinkya Rahane's bat.
Spinning into Jinx, who once again presents a front foot defense. Muted shout for a leg before, to no avail.
Better length. Just drops it a little behind, the ball has room to breathe and turns. Jinx defends it in front of FSL.
Quite full on middle and leg, too full for the ball to turn. Easy enough for Rahane to press forward and defend.
No bounce at all on this occasion. Fired way across, the Indian skipper doesn't play at it. Dickwella bends low to take it as it falls short of him and gets a bit of a sting on his fingers.
Length delivery on off, moves across and meets the ball with a solid, straight bat.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Quite full in length, driven to mid on by Virat for no run.
Straighter in line, on middle and leg, Kohli adjusts his body and defends it out well.
Length delivery outside the line of off stump, Kohli with an open face dabs it past gully for a couple of runs.
Vishwa Fernando (10-1-42-0) is back on for another spell.

Spinning down, Rahane puts his bat ahead of his front pad to defend. It goes off something as the keeper takes it. Loud appeal, shut down. Replays show why, the ball brushed the pad and there was no bat involved.
Shout for a leg before, turned down. Pitched outside leg which ended everything right there. Rahane was ahead to block but was rapped on the front pad.
Poor line, down the leg side. Rahane still tries to go after it but misses.
Doesn't use his feet much on this occasion, just hangs his bat and meets the turning ball with the full face.
Spinning away on middle and off, Rahane is half-forward in defense.
Ajinkya Rahane is the next batsman in.

OUT! Another wicket down! Sri Lanka have made their way back into this game in some fashion. Expecting the ball to turn in, Pujara goes back to cut but the ball holds its line. Takes the outside edge and brushes off Dickwella's gloves, before eventually settling into Angelo Mathews' safe hands. Good catch, wasn't an easy one by any means.
Skates down the wicket and clips it through mid-wicket. Single to end the over.
Drops this in front of covers and both batsmen hare across.
Drives this full delivery to mid off for no run.
Gets big on the ball by coming ahead and buries it into the track.
Mid off is pushed back.
FOUR! Drifting in on middle and leg, Kohli gets his front leg out of the way and blasts a straight drive across the boundary line. Super shot.
Tossed up on off, Kohli lunges ahead and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Plants his front foot forward and defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Straighter one on the stumps, Kohli off his back foot punches it through mid-wicket. Single taken.
Darts it quite full outside off, Cheteshwar fails in his attempt to put bat on ball. It goes through the keeper's leg as well which enables the batsmen to take a bye.
Works it with the spin just in front of the short leg fielder.
Wrong 'un on off, going away, VK is back in his crease as he offers a solid punch to covers. One run added to the total.
Quicker ball, on middle and leg, flicked to square leg for a single. The Indian skipper is off the mark.
Similar ball, played in the same area as the previous delivery. Just to the left of short cover this time.
Outside off, spinning away, plays with the spin and pushes it straight to short cover.
Loopy and full just outside off, Kohli takes a good stride ahead and blocks.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Kohli clears his front leg and pushes it back to the bowler.
Virat Kohli walks in at No.4.

OUT! Malinda with his second! He's been superb since he's come on and has dismissed the two dangerous, set openers. Tossed up delivery, Dhawan kneels and sweeps it hard. This time, however, he doesn't keep it down and it flies towards Chandimal at square leg. He moves to his left and takes a good, sharp catch. Sri Lanka rejoice, but both the Indian wickets to fall have been soft dismissals. Can be argued that they threw it away. The Lankans won't mind, this is their chance to make further inroads.
Down the leg side, Dhawan works it through backward square leg for a run.
Dhawan has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shimmies down the track, clears his front leg and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shikhar Dhawan is the first Indian opener to score two centuries in an away series since 2011.
Short and flat well outside off, room on offer which Pujara uses well. Punches it a bit square through cover-point for a double.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

EDGED AND PAST FIRST SLIP! Tossed up outside off, Pujara is forward to defend but the ball spins away just enough to take the edge. Fortunately for Pujara, flies to the right of Mathews at slip and it's just wide. Was short of him too.
Lakshan Sandakan returns to the attack.
Good use of the feet, brings his wrists into play as well as he works it towards mid on for a quick single.
Hangs deep inside his crease and meets the ball with the full face of the bat.
Short, flat and quick, sliding down leg, Pujara goes back to whip it away on the leg side but is hit on the pads.
Gets close to the pitch, too close and ends up driving it to mid on.
Tossed up and it's on middle and leg, flicks it away sweetly into the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket region for a run.
Dropped outside leg, Dhawan kneels down to sweep but misses and is hit on the front pad. Muted appeal, nothing from the umpire.
Opts to leave the ball outside his off stump. End of the over.
Banged in short, too short for Pujara to want to fiddle with. He doesn't play any shot at it.
Cheteshwar Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sprayed on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Shot! The timing is excellent on this one. Short of a length around off, Dhawan drags the pull through mid-wicket and gets one more boundary to his name.
Going across, Dhawan uses the angle well and dabs it behind point. In the gap and that will fetch him a couple of runs.
Shortens the length again, punched off the back foot straight to the bowler.

Short and sliding in, Pujara is early into the pull shot but misses. The ball hits him high on the thigh pads, lobs up and takes the back of his bat and lands next to the stumps in front of the slip fielder.
Stays back and keeps it out.
Pujara jumps down the track and wrists it towards short mid-wicket. The fielder there dives and makes a fine stop. Good effort.

Down the leg side, Dhawan manages to whip it fine down the leg side, through Dickwella's legs. Three runs taken. But hold on, seems there's no bat involved. The ball missed everybody. So, byes signalled by the umpire.
Just back of a driving length on off, Shikhar gets close to the pitch and pushes it to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short delivery outside off, Che sees it early and drops it down on the off side.
Short of a good length, picks it off his hips and tucks it towards the square leg area.
Well outside off, not troubling the batsman. Left alone.
Angling in from a length on middle and off, Pujara closes the face a wee bit early and gets a leading edge in front of covers.
Back of a length ball angling across Dhawan, he opens the bat face and dabs it to point for a single.
Use of the feet again from Shikhar, knocks it down to long on and takes one.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks.

FOUR! Not sure when will the Sri Lankans learn. You don't bowl that to anybody, especially to somebody like Shikhar Dhawan. Short and wide, Dhawan smashes it through point and sends it across the rope.
Steps out once more and defends it by getting to the pitch.
6th Test ton for Shikhar Dhawan!

FOUR! There it is, hundred for Dhawan! What a knock, what a man. Scores so freely whenever he plays. Was given a life early in the morning, but he hasn't looked back since. Removes his helmet and points two fingers on each hand skywards, looking at the dressing room. Dances down and drives it through the right of mid off for a boundary.
Looped up outside off, Dhawan presses forward in defense.

What just happened here? Could have been nasty, but Pujara looks unfazed, which is good to see. Kumara with a bumper on off, Che doesn't judge the length well at all. Just stands there and gets hit on the helmet.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length outside off, cutting back in, kept out solidly off the back foot.
Comes back in from around off, on a good length, Pujara stands his ground and defends it down on the off side.
Full ball tailing back in, Pujara plays it off the inner half behind square leg and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Short and outside off, cut away square on the off side for a single.
Another tossed up ball around middle, Cheteshwar blocks it by getting behind the line of the delivery.
Similar delivery, Pujara blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Pujara strides forward and defends.
The new age wall, Cheteshwar Pujara is the next man walking in.
Drinks! It will taste sweeter and be far more refreshing for the Lankans now that they have broken through.

OUT! Rahul throws away yet another start! That's bowled flatter around middle, KL tried to go big over mid on, but didn't get to the pitch of the ball. All he managed to do is find a leaping Karunaratne there to perfection. The opener is distraught and why not! He had a 100 for the taking yet he's thrown it away.
Slider around off, Rahul goes on to the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Starts of with a flat ball outside off, Dhawan punches it off the back foot to long on for one more run.
Malinda Pushpakumara will bowl for the first time today.
Length ball starting outside off and angling in to Rahul. He defends it from the crease.
Full and straight delivery on middle and leg, the opener drives it down the ground but finds the mid on fielder.
Short ball around middle, pulled away to deep square leg for one run.
Length ball around middle, KL plays it with soft hands to the right of short mid-wicket for a quick run.
Fuller ball outside off, Dhawan drives it to cover, where the fielder dives and makes a half-stop. The batsmen run one.
Full ball on off, driven straight to covers.
Flatter on off, Rahul tries to push it with soft hands and the ball takes the edge of the bat and lands in front of slip.
Tossed up outside off, Dhawan drives it through covers for another single.
Looped up outside off, driven to the left of mid off for a single.
Floated around middle, played towards wide mid on for a run.
Very full ball outside off, Dhawan goes for the drive and misses the ball completely. The ball lobs off the keeper's gloves and lands in Mathews' hands.
Loopy ball around his legs, KL tucks it past the diving short leg fielder and takes a single.
Full ball around middle and leg, driven back to mid on.

Aah! Glorious shot again results in something less than what it deserved. Good length ball on middle angling in to the batsman, Rahul maintains his balance and flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder from mid on chases it down and saves a run for his side.
Shorter ball around off, Rahul plays it calmly from the crease.
That's bowled on a length around off, defended from within the crease.
Very full ball on middle, dug away towards wide mid on for a single.
Full ball outside off, driven to mid off.
Lahiru Kumara is back on for another spell.
Floated on middle, bunted onto the ground.
Short ball on off and middle, pulled away in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Loopy ball on off, punched off the back foot.

FOUR! Another ball where Dhawan churns runs off Sandakan! Floated around leg, Dhawan sweeps fine, the ball passes the keeper and rolls away to the fine leg fence. Replays show that it came off the back of his bat. This partnership between Dhawan and Rahul is now the highest opening stand against Sri Lanka in Sri Lanka.
Short wrong 'un outside off, cut to point.
Loopy ball going down the leg side, Rahul tries to sweep, misses. The keeper, too, misses and lets a bye.
FOUR! Aaah, those small margins in cricket! That's just a fraction short and wide of off, Dhawan wristily cuts it to the right of backward point. The ball races away to the fence in a jiffy!
Length ball, dragged his pull to mid on.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dhawan tries to cut and gets a bottom edge on that.
Length ball on off, SD shows the full face of the bat in blocking it.
The well-left game continues in the form of a length ball outside off, which Dhawan lets it go.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot straight to the cover fielder.
Floated around middle, defended from the crease.
Fired this down the leg side, Rahul tries to play that and misses.
Tossed up on middle, played off the back foot.
A wrong 'un, well read and punched off the back foot through covers for a run.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the Delhi Dasher! Tossed up around off, Dhawan gets down and slogs it through mid-wicket yet again for another boundary. He's just toying with Sandakan at the moment.

FOUR! Rank short delivery is dealt with in the manner it should be! That was pitched way short, giving ample time for a well-set Dhawan to rock back and pull it with disdain through mid-wicket to increase the boundary count.
A tad fuller around off, pushed to covers.
Length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.

Good ball. Sri Lanka need more of such balls if they are to dislodge this pair. Length ball on middle, swinging away from the batsman, who pokes his bat tentatively at that. The ball misses the bat and lands in the keeper's gloves.
Length ball on off, played off the front foot.
Length ball on off, pushed towards covers for a run. This is the highest opening stand in Tests in this year.
FOUR! DHAWAN BASHES IT! Full ball outside off, Dhawan drives it exquisitely through covers to increase his tally of runs and boundaries.
Loops it up on middle and leg, KL blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball on middle, punched off the back foot.
Quicker ball down the leg side, Rahul goes after it and misses.
Loopy ball outside off, punched away off the back foot through covers. One more run added to the score.
Tossed up around off, Dhawan powerfully sweeps it straight at Mendis at short leg. So, Mendis continues to take shots on his body!
Sandakan bowls it slower through the air outside off, the ball spins away as Dhawan pokes his bat at that.
Length ball on middle, defended showing the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball on middle, played it wide of mid on for another run.
Length ball on his pads, flicked away to mid-wicket for a run. That brings up the 150 for India.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahul punches it off the back foot to the bowler. A big no ball as Vishwa oversteps.
Length ball outside off, KL defends it from with the crease.
Short cover in place now.
Length ball outside off, arms shouldered by Rahul.

FOUR! Exquisite! His timing and placement are just getting better and better. Length ball outside off, punched away through covers. The ball teased the fielder at sweeper cover briefly, before rolling away to the ropes.
Tossed up on his pads, played to short leg. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end, misses and that results in a run.
Short non-spinning ball on middle and leg, pulled away towards deep square leg for one run.
That's bowled with some air outside off, Dhawan offers his pads instead of his bat.
Floated outside off, Dhawan goes for the sweep and completely misses the ball.
Tossed up around middle, Rahul steps down and drives it to long on for a run.
Looped up on middle, played back to the bowler with soft hands.
Bowls it on a length outside off and slightly swinging in, Shikhar shoulders arms to let that go.
That's bowled on a length well outside off, Dhawan tries to cut and misses.
Length ball outside off, punched away through covers for a run.
Full and straight around off, blocks showing the full face of the bat.
That's bowled straight outside off, played towards point for a single.
Length ball on off, blocked off the front foot.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Floated on off, driven to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Looped up on off, punched back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Another chance gone begging! Short and quicker ball outside off, this one didn't turn. Rahul went back to cut and got a thick outside edge that flew from the left of Mathews at slip and raced away to the boundary. Mathews moved to his right and couldn't recover well to gather that chance. Rahul lives to fight another day!
Flatter this time outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up outside off and turning away from Dhawan, he doesn't bother playing that.
The men who matter are making their way out in the middle. Dhawan and Rahul to resume their innings with the bat, while it will be spin in the form of Lakshan Sandakan to start for Sri Lanka.
... Day One, Session Two ...

India, India, India! That's how this session panned out. It seemed that the Indians continued the battering of the Lankans from the previous game. Both the openers got to their respective half centuries and seem unstoppable at the moment. Sri Lanka missed some chances that came their way - more glaring being the dropped catch of Rahul and the Indian openers made them pay for it. The home side would hope for some magic potion in their lunch, which would make things go their way come the second session. Join us in a while.
Some flight from Dilruwan, Rahul skates down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
FOUR! Easy. Just too easy. The Lankan bowlers are just giving the runs away here. Full outside off, Rahul takes half a step forward and with a crisp drive finds the cover fence.
FOUR! Dropped short and Dilruwan pays the price for it. Outside off, Rahul rocks back in a jiffy and punches it sweetly through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
Sprayed on the pads, no trouble to tuck it behind square leg and take one.
Around the wicket to Dhawan, he leans forward and across to the full ball and flicks it to mid-wicket. The fielder there dives low to his left and stops the ball from going past him. Good save!
Turning in on middle and off, knocked down to long on as the batsmen jog across for a run.
Outside off, the southpaw pads it away on the off side.
FOUR! Loopy full toss and it's dispatched. Shikhar Dhawan gets low and sweeps it off the top edge over backward square leg for a boundary.
Comfortably outside off, wide enough for Shikhar to dab it to backward point.
Sliding into Dhawan's pads, he works it away on the on side. No run taken.
Spinning away from a shorter length, well outside off, Dhawan flashes at it but misses. The pace probably did him in a bit as it was a bit quicker.
A bit of loop as he drops it around off, draws Dhawan forward who defends it well. That's the area he needs to keep bowling at. Perfect length.

Wonderful partnership this for India. The tweet by Rohan Abeysinghe drives home the point - This is the 1st time an opening pair has a century stand at Pallekele in 6 tests. The previous best 81 vs Aus in 2011 by Dilshan & Para.
Knocks this through the covers and takes two runs as the sweeper mops it up.
Prods forward in defense and confidently deals with it. There wasn't much turn on offer, so no problem for the batsman.
Pushes this in front of the covers but gets no run for it.
Darted on the stumps, driven hard straight to silly mid on though.
Stays rooted inside his crease and taps it down on the off side with soft hands.
Full and flat outside off, off the inner half Rahul defends it to square leg.
Rahul eases this full delivery down to long on and retains strike with a single.
Short in length, turned away on the leg side for a single.
Turning in on the pads, off the back foot KL nudges it behind square on the leg side. One run added to the total.
A lot of revs from Sandakan, just outside off, Rahul prods ahead and keeps it out.
Very full on off, dipping in, drilled straight to short extra cover.
Not the ideal start he'd have liked. Short and wide outside off, cracked square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
One of the two chinamen in this game involved in the action now. Lakshan Sandakan is brought into the bowling attack. A wicket would be nice for the Sri Lankans at this point in time.
Floats it just outside off, another back foot defense from KL Rahul. End of a maiden over from Perera.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Provides a decent amount of flight on this one, Rahul is forward in defense.
Pushed quick once more, outside off, moves across and taps it down in front of point with soft hands.
Drops it a touch short, outside off but close to the off stump. Rahul goes back to cut but ends up mistiming it into the off side.
Quick and full on the stumps, goes right behind the line and defends it on the on side.
Full ball attacking the stumps, pushed towards mid on for a brisk run.
Down the leg side this time, left alone by the batsman.
Instantly goes full again. Should be quite patient, the previous delivery is the length he needs to stick with more often. Full and outside off, it's driven to short extra cover.
On the fourth stump line, tailing back in, Rahul covers the line well and lets it be. Kumara needs to hit this length more regularly. Has been too wayward since morning.
Lands it on a length this time, the right-hander hangs inside the crease and defends it down on the off side.
Fuller length delivery fired outside off, KL meets it with a straight blade as he offers a punch to the left of short extra cover.
Solid in defense as Dhawan presses forward in defense. Meets it with the full face of the bat and ends the over without any problem.
Fast again, Rahul goes deep inside his crease and whips it in front of square leg. Single taken.
Rare dot ball. It's pushed quicker through the air, Rahul pushes it back down the track.
Tossed up on middle stump, kneels down and sweeps it behind square leg for one more.
Works it off his pads and turns it away to the mid-wicket area for one.
Flat and short, sliding in around off, Dhawan backs away a touch and punches it through the covers for a single.
Length ball around off, played towards point for a single.
Short ball on off, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
9th Test fifty for KL Rahul. He becomes the first Indian to score 7 consecutive Test fifties.
Classy flick to get to his fifty. Full on middle and leg, Rahul plays it wide of mid on for a brace. He's been getting those runs on a regular basis, now he needs to get a bigger score.
That's a tad fuller, Dhawan taps it towards cover-point for a run.
Length ball blocked from within the crease.
A low full toss is pushed to mid off. No run there.
Tossed up on off, steps down and drives towards long off for a single.
Loopy ball on off, Dhawan defends after getting to the pitch of the ball.
Fired on middle and leg, flicked away backward of square on the leg side for one run.
A stumping chance! Loopy ball on middle, Rahul charges down and as he tries to get bat on to that, the ball takes his pads and goes to the left of Dickwella. He doesn't manage to take the ball.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul strides out and blocks.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, flicked away to fine leg for a brace.
That's blocked from the crease by Shikhar.
Dhawan gets a change of bat. The previous defensive shot resulted in a chunk of the bat coming off.
Length ball, defended from within the crease.
4th Test fifty for Shikhar Dhawan.

FOUR! Another boundary ball from Kumara results in India getting to 100! Full and outside off, Dhawan powerfully cover drives it for a boundary. A well-deserved half century for the Delhi lad. This is also the first century stand between Dhawan and Rahul.
Length ball on off, Dhawan tries to punch it off the back foot and gets an inside edge on to his pad.
Length ball on off, KL plays it towards point and the batsmen rush for a quick single.

FOUR! Kumara comes back, a boundary welcomes him! Spears it full and wide outside off, Rahul dishes out a glorious cover drive. This shot is so well timed, that even the outfield couldn't play a role in helping Sri Lanka here.
Lahiru Kumara comes back on for another spell. He was costly in his first spell.
Tossed up on off, played defensively from the crease by Shikhar.
Air given on middle, KL punches back to long on for another run.
Flat ball on off and middle, Rahul bunts it on to the ground.
Floated on off, Dhawan gets down to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, punched off the back foot to long on for one run.
Loopy ball outside off, played with soft hands in front of point for a quick run.
Shikhar drives this full ball through covers for a run.
Length ball, Dhawan blocks it towards point.
This length ball is pushed through covers for another single.
Length on off, played towards point for a single.
Fuller ball on off, played from the crease.
Length ball pushed towards mid on for a quick single.
Tossed up on middle, punched to long on for a run.
Flatter on his pads, flicked away through square leg for a single.
FOUR! SHORT AND SMASHED! Perera bowls a half-tracker, Dhawan rocks back and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for another boundary. That's not great bowling to be honest.
Given a bit more air, Dhawan pushes it defensively on the leg side.
Flatter on middle, flicked away to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Dhawan plays it up and over for a boundary. Tossed up around off, he steps down the track and lofts it over mid off. The ball rushes away to the long off fence.
Full ball on his pads, flicked away through mid-wicket for three runs. The fielder at mid on got there and misfielded that, while the fielder at deep mid-wicket did the tidying up.
Fuller ball blocked from the crease.
Fuller ball defended off the front foot.
Length ball bunted off the front foot.
Fuller ball, flicked away to backward square leg for a run.
Fuller slower ball on leg, Rahul looks to play on the leg side and gets a leading edge that falls where silly point could be.

Drinks break! The first hour has clearly belonged to the Indians yet again, but not before the generous Lankans let off a couple of chances. The hosts will hope this drinks interval would refresh them and spur them on to make a few inroads into the Indian batting line-up.
Bowled on off, played from within the crease.
Floated on off, Dhawan steps down and defends.
Tossed up on off and middle, driven back to the bowler.
Floated on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.

Harsha Bhogle on-air provides some information on the Lankans training today morning. He says that not once did he see any of their bowlers bowl from behind the crease. Quite surprising at such a level.
Loopy ball on off and middle, Rahul plays it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to square leg.
A spinner starts off with a no ball due to over stepping! That batsman defends it from the crease.
Spin in the form of Dilruwan Perera is brought on.
FOUR! Bad ball, punished! Full and straight on his pads, Dhawan flicks it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, played towards covers.
Why play aerially when you can play such wonderful strokes? Full ball outside off, driven beautifully through covers for three runs. Thanks to the slow outfield, a run is saved for the Lankans.

DROPPED! How costly would this prove? Fuller ball, Rahul tries to go over the top on this two-paced wicket and almost pays the price. Kumara is late in turning and running back from mid on and drops it even after getting two hands to that. The batsmen take two, to rub salt on the Lankan wounds.
Length ball edged towards slips.
