The commentators on-air feel that the slips are slightly deeper, as there isn't much carry available. Karunaratne wasn't happy with the shape of the ball and hence took it to the umpire. He checked it with the help of the 8-shaped gauge and are happy with it. Play resumes.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Length ball, punched towards covers for another run. This now becomes the highest opening stand in the series.

Another lovely shot doesn't yield the desired runs here, owing to the slow outfield. Length ball outside off, punched away through covers. Rahul had timed it so sweetly that he expected four and hence ran lethargically for a couple.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, blocked off the front foot.
Short ball, pulled away to deep square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Rahul tentatively pokes at that. The ball takes the inside half of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket and the batsmen settle with a run.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahul gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball outside off, played towards covers for a single.
Another mistake by the slip cordon. Fuller ball outside off, Rahul edges it through second slip. The fielder there doesn't get down in time to stop it and the batsmen run two.
Length ball outside off, Rahul tries to cut it off the back foot, gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards the on side.
Fuller ball on off, played off the front foot.
That's where the Sri Lankans should bowl more often. Fuller ball swinging a tad away from Rahul, who pokes at it and gets beaten.

Full gentle pace ball on his pads, flicked away through backward square leg for a single. Fifty up for India inside the first hour. Russel Arnold on air jokes that he mentioned in his pitch report that batting will be difficult in the first hour.
Full ball outside off, played solidly off the front foot to covers.
Length ball going across Rahul, who points his bat skywards to let it go.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Back of a length ball angling into Dhawan, he plays it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Glorious! Short ball outside off, Dhawan times his cut wonderfully through backward point for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, cut straight to point.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot straight to the short cover fielder.
Full ball outside off, played to point.
Dhawan cuts that length ball outside off to deep point for a single.
Length ball on his pads, tucked away to fine leg for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, left alone.
Bowls on a gentle pace on off, Rahul defends it off the front foot.

Medium pacer Dimuth Karunaratne is brought on to bowl. We're going to see quite a lot of him with the ball in the match. He dismissed Cheteshwar Pujara in the previous game, can he provide a breakthrough here as well?
Fuller ball on middle, flicked away towards wide mid on for another run.

Full and swinging ball outside off, Dhawan leans and drives that beautifully through covers. Cricket can sometimes be unfair on you, that wonderful shot resulted in just three, as the slow outfield allows Sandakan to field and return the ball to the keeper.
A tad full on middle, played towards mid-wicket for no run.
Length ball well wide of off, left alone.
Length ball on off and angling into the batsman. Dhawan jumps and wears it on his pads. The players appeal which the umpire denies.
Length ball, flicked away to mid-wicket for a run.

Length ball outside off, Rahul gets an inside edge on that and the ball rolls towards point. They decide to take a quick single, hesitated a bit but eventually completed the single easily. 16 runs off that over.
Leaves that length ball outside off alone.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for KL! Short ball on off, Rahul goes for the pull instinctively and gets a top edge. The ball goes on the bounce to the backward square leg boundary.
FOUR! Classy Rahul! Kumara steams in from over the wicket to the righty and spears it full on middle at 144 kph. Rahul just times it brilliantly past mid on for another boundary.
Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot through point. Upul Tharanga chases the ball and keeps the batsmen down to three.
FOUR! CLUBBED! Kumara runs in from round the wicket and bowls it short and wide of off. Dhawan stays on the back foot and cuts it through cover-point for another glorious boundary.
Back of a length ball on leg, the ball rolls towards square leg of the inner half. A maiden over by Fernando.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, Rahul looked to push that defensively. The ball rolled over to the on side off the inner half of his bat.
Full ball down the leg side, KL tries to flick but misses.

Short ball just outside off, Rahul tries to punch it off the back foot towards covers. He gets an inside edge onto his back leg and it rolls towards first slip. That ball was too close to him to play that shot.
Bowled full on off, he plays it from the crease showing the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball played straight to the fielder in front of square on the leg side.
Yorker outside off, dug away next to the stumps on the off side for a run. 11 runs off that over.
Length ball on off, played with soft hands towards covers for a quick single. The fielder there has a quick shy at the non-striker's end and misses. Dhawan had just made it in.
FOUR! Cuts it hard and gets the desired result. Short ball outside off, Dhawan gets the room that he wants. He collects a boundary by playing it through point.
Full ball outside off at 140 kph, swinging in a bit. Rahul lets it go to the keeper. The ball dies down before it reaches the keeper, who makes a diving attempt to stop the ball but concedes a bye.
Length ball defended from the crease by showing the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Good shot! Very full ball outside off, an attempted yorker converted into a low full toss by Rahul, who guides it through the gully region and into the third man fence for a boundary.
Fuller ball on off and middle, played to mid on.

EDGED BUT FOUR! A tad fuller ball moving just a bit, draws Dhawan forward who looks to drive. Gets a thick edge that dies down towards second slip and past the diving third slip. The ball races away to the third man fence for a boundary.
A tad fuller, but outside off, Shikhar lets it go.
Spears in at 140 kph, Dhawan has nothing to do with that and lets the keeper collect it.
Another length ball outside off, arms are shouldered to it by the batsman.
Length ball well outside off, left alone by Dhawan.
Length ball outside off coming in slightly, Rahul gets an inside edge on to his pads which draws a stifled appeal from the Lankans. The umpire stays unmoved.
Full outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Length ball outside off, swinging in a bit, KL has nothing to do with that.
Length ball on middle, tailing in. Rahul fails to get bat to ball and gets hit high on his pad.
Back of a length ball starting on off and swinging down the leg side, KL shoulders arms and lets it go through to Dickwella.
Starts with a back of a length ball on middle and leg, Rahul plays it from within his crease.
Lahiru Kumara to share the new ball from the other end.
Length ball on his pads, he fails to get bat on to that. The ball hits his pads and they sneak a leg bye.
Full and straight on middle, tailing in a tad. KL flicks it past a diving square leg for another couple.
Length ball outside off, Rahul leaves it unharmed.
Length ball just outside off, Rahul covers the stumps and shoulders arms.
Full on middle and leg, Rahul flicks it through square leg for a brace to get underway. It's always a nice feeling to get some runs on the board off your first ball.
Starts over the wicket, bowls a fuller ball angling into Dhawan, he flicks it to fine leg to get off the mark with a single.

The players are out in the middle. It's relatively dark out there with chances of rain through the day. The Lankans have taken their positions out in the field. Shikhar Dhawan and KL Rahul to open, with the former taking strike. Vishwa Fernando to kick things off with the new ball. Three slips and a gully in place. Let's roll...

Dinesh Chandimal says they would have batted first as well. Mentions one can't control the toss so now just have to restrict the Indians as well as possible. Continues saying India played some good cricket in the last two games, so his side just has to keep its spirits up and do its best. Lets everyone know there are three changes - Rangana Herath, Nuwan Pradeep and Dhananjaya de Silva are out for Lahiru Kumara, Vishwa Fernando and Lakshan Sandakan.

Virat Kohli reckons that the wicket looks similar to the second game but not as dry. Feels that it will break down from the end of day 2. Says they expect resilience from sides in Tests and it was a challenge in the previous match which they expect from their oppositions. Admits that he knows that he hasn't played the same side in consecutive games and those are due to circumstances and not some pattern followed consciously. Confirms the one change in the side, that of Ravindra Jadeja being replaced by Kuldeep Yadav.
Toss - Virat Kohli wins yet another toss and INDIA WILL BAT FIRST.

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold says it's a nice hard wicket with a good covering of grass. Adds cracks are there but it won't really affect things much till the 4th or 5th day. States the first hour in particular will be torrid for the batsmen with the ball moving about. Reckons hitting through the line will be difficult at first, but will get easier as the game goes on. Ends saying that all in all, the wicket has something for everybody and it makes for a good game of cricket.

Hello and warm welcome to our coverage of the final Test between Sri Lanka and India in Pallekele. India are on a roll after their thumping wins over the Sri Lankans and the series is placed 2-0 in the visitors' favour. India would be eyeing their first-ever whitewash away from home in a minimum of three-match Test series. The hosts would be boosted, hopefully, by their second innings show in Colombo and would hope that they put up a good fight to avoid an embarrassing whitewash at home. The Asian giants, on the other hand, would look at nothing less than another rout of the home side. Stay with us as we bring to you all the action in a while.
